howItWasMade.title: How this card was made
paragraphs: Two phones, one choreography: the layers leave the host screen at the same moment they appear above it in your camera.
The animation was designed by one AI model in a long autonomous run; the camera tracking, rooms and this page were built by another, against a shared contract.
